title: 12 Best Viewpoints in Chengdu
description: Discover the 12 best viewpoints in Chengdu, from panoramic cityscapes atop skyscrapers to serene historical gardens and majestic mountain vistas. Plan your scenic adventure in Sichuan's capital.

places.name: Longquanshan Urban Forest Park (City Balcony)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The "City Balcony" vista itself; bring a thermos of local tea for the experience.

places.name: IFS Panda Sculpture Rooftop Garden
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A selfie with the giant panda; explore the various art installations on the rooftop.

places.name: Niccolo Hotel Bar (The Conservatory)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their signature "Panda's Dream" cocktail while gazing at the city lights.

places.name: Wangjiang Pavilion Park (望江楼公园)
places.priceRange: Park entrance free, Pavilion area CNY 20 | ~$3 USD
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Climb to the upper levels of Chongli Tower for the best river views. Enjoy a traditional tea in one of the park's tea houses.

places.name: Qingcheng Mountain (Laojun Pavilion)
places.priceRange: Entrance CNY 80, Cable Car CNY 60 (round trip) | ~$20 USD
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The panoramic view from Laojun Pavilion after the hike; try some local mountain tea from vendors.

places.name: Dujiangyan Irrigation System (Mount Yulei Viewpoint)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The comprehensive view of the system from Mount Yulei; cross the Anlan Suspension Bridge for an exhilarating experience.

places.name: Wuhou Shrine (武侯祠)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The main temple courtyard and the tranquil bamboo path leading to Liu Bei's tomb.

places.name: Kuanzhai Alley (Wide & Narrow Alleys)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A cup of traditional Sichuan tea in a courtyard tea house; capture the intricate door carvings and red lanterns.

places.name: Jinli Ancient Street (锦里古街)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Sample various local street snacks like San Da Pao (three cannons) and enjoy the illuminated streetscape.

places.name: Taikoo Li & Daci Temple (太古里 & 大慈寺)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Explore the temple's quiet courtyards, then grab a coffee at a modern cafe overlooking the bustling plaza.

places.name: Du Fu Thatched Cottage (杜甫草堂)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The main thatched cottage reconstruction and the tranquil stream winding through the garden.

places.name: The St. Regis Chengdu - The Manor (Bar)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic Old Fashioned or a local-inspired cocktail, paired with the changing city lights.
